title:
Your IT Career in the AI Era:
Lessons from 20 Years of Tech Change
agenda: 18:30 – 20:00 Presentation and Q&A (in person and online)

zh.title:
AI 时代，
IT 人的路怎么走？

linkedin.intro: Will AI take our IT jobs? How will our roles change, and will we still have jobs in a few years?
linkedin.session_line: a session on the AI era with **Jerome Brown**, Principal Consultant at **Mantel** and Microsoft MVP.
linkedin.speaker_para: No one can see the future, but Jerome believes we can learn a lot from past technology changes. Drawing on 20 years of adapting to new technologies, he will share what those shifts have taught him, then turn to what they mean for IT careers in the AI era.
bullets: What 20 years of technology change can tell us about the AI shift
How IT roles have changed before, and how they are changing now
How experienced IT professionals can adapt
What students and beginners should focus on to build a successful career
Practical ways to keep your skills relevant as AI tools evolve
linkedin.closing: Whether you are an experienced IT professional, a student, someone starting out in tech, or simply wondering what AI means for your job, this session is for you. Pizza from 6:00 pm; the talk is delivered in English.

xiaohongshu.hook:
AI 越来越强，IT 人的工作还会在吗？🤔

这次 CITANZ 基督城活动，请到了 Mantel 的 Principal Consultant、Microsoft MVP —— Jerome Brown。
xiaohongshu.body:
过去 20 年，Jerome 经历了一轮又一轮的新技术。他的看法是：没人能预知未来，但过去的每一次技术变革，都能教会我们很多。

这次分享，他会聊聊：
· 从过去 20 年的技术变迁里，我们能学到什么
· 已经在 IT 行业的人，该怎么适应这一轮变化
· 学生和刚入行的人，在 AI 时代应该把精力放在哪

🍕 18:00 起 Pizza + 交流，🗣️ 全程英文分享
👥 适合谁来：IT 从业者、在读学生、想转行进 IT 的朋友
xiaohongshu.signoff: 评论区留下你最想问 Jerome 的问题，我们挑几个带到现场 Q&A 👇

meetup.abstract:
The growth of AI makes many people wonder about the future of IT jobs. How will our roles change? Will we still have jobs in a few years?

On Wednesday 28 October, Jerome Brown, a Principal Consultant at Mantel and Microsoft MVP, will share his experience of adapting to new technologies over the past 20 years. While no one can see the future, Jerome believes we can learn a lot from past technology changes.

In this talk, Jerome will explain how IT professionals can adapt to these changes and what students and beginners should focus on to build a successful career in the AI era.
cover: **Lessons:** what 20 years of technology change can tell us about the AI shift
**Roles:** how IT roles have changed before, and how they are changing now
**Adapting:** how experienced IT professionals can adapt
**Starting out:** what students and beginners should focus on
meetup.audience: IT professionals at any stage, students, career changers, and anyone wondering what AI means for their job. Come early for pizza, and bring your questions.
meetup.bio: **Jerome Brown** is a Principal Consultant at Mantel and a Microsoft MVP, with 20 years of experience adapting to new technologies.
